title: Home
description:
HOME is a first-person psychological and action-horror game set aboard an abandoned corporate transit
station in the year 3045.
The player takes the role of Diego, a veteran of a brutal war and a failed subject of a military augmentation
program. Struggling financially and attempting to build a future for himself, Diego accepts a dangerous
contract with several companions to investigate the disappearance of the corporate transit hub Zipacna.
What initially appears to be a high-paying recovery and investigation job quickly becomes a fight for
survival.
The crew discovers that Zipacna has become a sealed nightmare inhabited by grotesque biological and
cybernetic creatures known as the Core Infected. The station contains evidence of an unknown force or
phenomenon emerging from beyond known human space, as well as survivors whose minds and bodies
have been permanently altered.
Diego must navigate the abandoned facility, fight increasingly dangerous creatures, solve environmental
problems, manage limited resources, uncover the truth behind the station, and confront the psychological
consequences of what he discovers.
1
At its heart, HOME is a story about survival, guilt, sacrifice, family, and the meaning of home when
everything familiar has been taken away.
